question: Which of the following diseases is transmitted by the bite of an infected phlebotomine sandfly, characterised by irregular fever, weight loss and enlargement of the spleen and liver?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Visceral leishmaniasis.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Visceral leishmaniasis**, also known as **kala-azar**, is a parasitic disease caused by the **Leishmania donovani parasite,** which is transmitted by the bite of an** infected phlebotomine sandfly.**
 
• The disease is characterized by **irregular fever, weight loss,** and **enlargement of the spleen and liver**, which can lead to** serious health complications** if left untreated.
 
• Treatment for visceral leishmaniasis typically involves a combination of drugs such as** liposomal amphotericin B, miltefosine, and paromomycin.**
 
• Prevention measures for the disease include using **insect repellent**, wearing **protective clothing**, and sleeping under **insecticide-treated bed nets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Japanese encephalitis** is a viral disease transmitted by** mosquitoes.**

 
 
• It can cause **inflammation of the brain** and is endemic in parts of Asia.
 
 
 
• **Diarrhea** is a common condition characterized by **loose or watery stools.**
 
 
• It can be caused by a variety of factors such as **infections, food intolerances, and medications.**
 
 
 
• **Anaplasmosis** is a tick-borne disease caused by the **Anaplasma phagocytophilum bacterium**.
 
 
• It can cause **fever, headache, and muscle aches.**
